name: costa-bus-tracker
description: Rastreo GPS en tiempo real de autobuses de pasajeros en la Costa de Jalisco, México (fase 1: datos simulados).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace simulator && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @costa-bus/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace simulator && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
